description: Writes the one's complement of the 16-bit sum of a 22-word field in the structure into a trailing word. It then adds 30 to a routine pointer when a marker longword is found 30 bytes further on, and tail-jumps through that pointer.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:c/SetPatch:13:0000

description: Opens the disk resource through a library call and, if it is present and its 16-bit field is below 36, updates a counter in the structure and stores two library results in globals. key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:c/SetPatch:13:007C
name: check_flag_and_copy_word
description: Calls the routine pointed to by a stored handler slot and, when it returns nonzero, copies the 32-bit field at a fixed offset in the global structure into a global word.

description: Compares a stored word with a field of the global structure and returns unless they differ and the stored word is not minus one. Otherwise it tail-jumps through a stored routine pointer.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:c/SetPatch:13:00A8

description: Sets a flag word to 16384. key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:c/SetPatch:5:0042

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:0F08

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:1002
name: seek_file_position
description: Looks up a file handle and seeks through the dos.Seek library call, recording an error code from dos.IoErr when the handle is missing or the seek fails.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:108C
name: close_file_handle
description: Looks up a file handle and returns minus one when it is missing or has no open flag. Otherwise it closes the handle through the dos.Close library call and returns the result.

key: wing commander - platinum edition (1992)(mindscape)(disk 1 of 3)[h lsd]/Wing Commander - Platinum Edition (1992)(Mindscape)(Disk 1 of 3)[h LSD].adf:InstallWingCommander:0:10F4
name: open_file_with_protection

description: Returns the low 32 bits of the product of two 32-bit register values, built from 16-bit partial products.

description: Returns immediately without doing anything.
